company.shortDescription: A digital Marketplace of micro educational animations!
company.description: Labtoons.com is a digital Marketplace of micro educational animations that help teachers make learning simple and fun. It empowers schools to create visual storytelling presentations by their teachers. The technique is the combination of pre-designed 2D or 3D animations with the specific content they need to add to their lesson plans.

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $289,355 to $289,355, a 1x increase.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (+43 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (-11).
